shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY (combat, drops) is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through skylight glass (vision + light only; sealed for gameplay). Orders through glass = orders through air (clicks pass; RMB batch 2026-07-24).
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## RMB 1:1 PARITY BATCH (2026-07-24, user: "cross level right click construction still does not function; inherit any RMB-modifying mod") — built, UNTESTED
Architecture (pre-existing, kept): our GetOptions prefix redirects cross-level clicks into a NESTED call of the REAL FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions under ABCurrentMapSwap (currentMapIndex swap) + ABVirtualPosition (pawn at stair exit) — every vanilla provider and every mod's GetOptions patches run against the target map; options wrapped to route-then-execute. Fixes this batch:
1. **ROOT CAUSE of dead construction orders — stale captured-Job replay.** Vanilla work options capture a single-use Job OBJECT built at menu time under virtual state; replaying it minutes later at arrival dies silently (Job reuse, hauled/reserved-away material picks, stale closures). NEW `ReplayFresh`: on arrival the wrapped action re-runs the REAL GetOptions with the pawn genuinely standing there (map-view swap only if player is viewing elsewhere; Redirecting guard), invokes the fresh option matched by label — exact first, digit-stripped second (labels embed live counts) — captured action only as last-resort fallback. Same label-match idiom as vanilla FloatMenuMap.StillValid. 1:1 + mod inheritance by construction (fresh regeneration includes all providers + patches). User confirmed the failure is NOT skylight-related; this staleness class is the mainline-path culprit.
2. **Column-wide selection eligibility**: ShouldRedirect accepted only viewed/below-pair pawns; a sky pawn selected while viewing the surface (colonist bar keeps selections) fell to vanilla, which rejects off-map pawns and showed NOTHING. Now any same-column pawn qualifies.
3. **Hop-chain routing** (`TryNextHop` + `RouteChainThenRun`): orders route hop by hop for any level distance; each hop re-resolves stairs LIVE at travel time (forbid flips/destroyed stairs re-route instead of dead-ending), re-arming ABPendingOrders per hop; final hop reroutes toward the destination cell. WrapOptions + RouteThenEngage now use the chain. Two-hop menus generate options from the clicked cell (documented approximation; chain re-validates hop by hop).
4. **Glass panes pass clicks** like open air in ResolveTargetMap (matches selection/overlay visibility). Additive fix, NOT the reported bug per user.
5. Nested GetOptions now receives the below-transformed click pos (identity today; funnel).
KNOWN GAPS: multi-pawn selections stay viewed/below-pair only (singles cover the construction complaint); menu-replacing mods (Achtung) still interact at prefix level via existing compat.

## DIRECT-TO-BLUEPRINT HAULING (2026-07-24) — built, UNTESTED
WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction (auto, Construction worktype, pre-existing) previously dropped its ferried load AT THE STAIRWELL, leaving a queued store-cargo job to walk it to a stockpile + a second local haul to the site — the indirection users saw. Now: the needing site (blueprint/frame, or the install blueprint in the mini branch) is resolved AT SCAN TIME (`ABConstructSupply.FindSiteNeeding`: nearest-to-exit, capped 80, Blueprint+BuildingFrame groups) and the manual bring-and-build order's arrival continuation (`FinishOnSite`, now internal: drop at site + forced deliver giver + blueprint->frame morph handling + 18t idle retry) is armed via ABPendingOrders — the builder carries the load ALL the way and builds. No site resolvable → old drop-at-stairs behavior stands (fail-open).

## BELOW-LEVEL LIGHTING (2026-07-24, user: "lighting visible across levels, correct shadowing/updating, cached for 3 open levels") — built, UNTESTED
LevelRenderer.DrawSections now draws the lower map's own `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` into the below band: lamp glow pools, skylight-shaft daylight, and roofed-room darkness (encoded in the mesh's vertex alpha by vanilla) — through the standard queue-clone machinery at offset 75 (over every content clone, under mask + all sky materials; solid sky cells can't bleed because sky materials paint over the band by queue construction). Included BY TYPE with an altitude-gate exemption (overlay altitude ~11 > content boundary 10). Composition math is IDENTICAL to vanilla same-map rendering (same vertex data + LightOverlay shader + shared sky globals) — no double-darkening (the historical regression was the MASK adding light-derived dim; mask untouched). **Updating is free**: GroundGlow/Roofs dirty flags regenerate the mesh via the MapMeshDrawerUpdate_First pump the band already runs per frame; clone materials cached in belowMats like every layer. Two-deep (sky->basement through stacked panes) and level-0 (surface->basement) inherit via the shared DrawSections path. Setting `belowLighting` (Rendering tab, default ON) + Keyed strings. Perf: zero new caches needed — dirty-driven regen + cached clones; per-frame adds only the extra DrawMesh calls for in-view lighting submeshes.

## ANIMAL FLOW FIX (2026-07-24) — built, UNTESTED
Pet food trips record home + scribed returns (ScanPetReturns, fed+idle, hop by hop, only pets WE moved); wild hard-overdue escape (WildAnimalMustOff interrupts eat/sleep squatters); linger-stagger overflow fixed. Ambient descent unchanged (flavor, setting-gated).

## BETTER ARCHITECT MENU COMPAT (2026-07-24) — built, UNTESTED
Detection-gated transpile of BAM's two current-map availability gates onto ColumnThingsOfDef (floors material list + stuff resolver). Info-box readout already column-correct via merged ResourceCounter. Verified non-interactions with BAM's own transpilers (different anchor instructions).

## PERFORMANCE PASS + PERF-MOD COMPLIANCE (2026-07-24) — complete
Four cache/hoist fixes; PO/TPT decompile-audited (scope-limited caches, reference-keyed GetComp rewrite composes with our CWTs); invariants documented in code. Standing rules: idempotent postfixes on cacheable methods; reference-keyed/versioned caches; never assume vanilla call cadence; no tick-exact logic on cacheable getters. New code this batch follows: ReplayFresh is event-scale; lighting adds no per-frame scans; FindSiteNeeding capped.

## BATCH D (skylights + mountain rivers/waterfalls) — built, UNTESTED (unchanged; skylight light now also VISIBLE from above via below-lighting)
## PARITY BATCH A — USER-VERIFIED. BATCH B — built, pending. BATCH C — built, pending (companions).
## FOOD OPTIMALITY — built (pet branch records return trips). LOGISTICS/AREAS/COMBAT — unchanged.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs (+skylights, mountainRivers, skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming, **belowLighting**).

## Test plan (current)
- **RMB parity verify (isolated, PRIORITY)**: undrafted pawn on sky, blueprint on surface w/ materials on surface -> right-click through air -> "Prioritize delivering/constructing" ENABLED -> pawn stairs down, delivers fresh (watch for label-matched replay in dev log); same with materials moved between click and arrival (fresh regen picks new stack); sky pawn selected while viewing surface -> full menu; basement pawn ordered to sky target (2-hop chain); construction option with pawn NOT assigned to Construction -> vanilla disabled row with reason; right-click through glass pane -> below options.
- **Direct-to-blueprint verify**: stock steel upstairs, blueprints downstairs, builder assigned Construction only -> carries steel straight to the blueprint and builds (no stockpile detour).
- **Below lighting verify**: night + lamps below -> pools visible from above; skylight shaft glow visible from sky view; roofed below rooms shade correctly; toggle setting off -> flat view; glow changes (lamp switch) update live; 3-level column FPS sanity.
- Animal flow, BAM (companion), Batch B+D, Batch C, perf-mod smoke, older stack — as before.

## Compat
(unchanged list) + Better Architect Menu (transpile compat). Performance mods decompile-audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (9th pass): **RMB 1:1 parity batch (fresh-regeneration replay, column-wide selection, hop-chain routing, glass clicks), direct-to-blueprint hauling leg, and below-level lighting built compile-green**. Next: RMB + lighting + direct-supply isolated test, then the standing verification stack.
